patch_description: Key change per the recommendation: extend group moves to perturb all vertices of the two smallest triangles simultaneously (hinge moves when they share a vertex), plus simulated annealing with restarts. The soft phase anneals temp 150→600; the hard phase now includes two-triangle coordinated kicks (~25% probability) with per-vertex independent noise, enabling escapes from degenerate configurations single-point moves can't resolve. Added best-of-basin memory and annealing acceptance (small worsening moves accepted early with decaying probability) to widen basin exploration.
